geopolitics_summary: EU methane rules delayed 2 years under US pressure; Russia Arctic LNG cut from EU from 2027; COP31 climate diplomacy stalls on fossil fuel transition language.

themes.headline: EU delays methane rules two years following US political pressure
themes.why_it_matters: Deferred compliance reduces near-term methane abatement costs for gas suppliers; extends lower operational discipline, potentially increasing leaked gas volumes. Softens EU climate stringency signal; supports gas narrative vs. power decarbonization through 2028.

themes.headline: Russia Arctic LNG cut from EU from 2027; gas rerouted to Asia
themes.why_it_matters: EU sanctions ban removes ~10% of global LNG supply from European market. Rerouting to Asia (longer voyage, higher transport cost) narrows LNG arb and tightens TTF. Reduces competitive LNG inflow; supports gas prices and power-to-coal switching risk.

themes.headline: US natural gas storage ends injection season 2% above five-year average
themes.why_it_matters: Above-normal US storage cushion reduces winter export urgency and LNG export margin; weakens arbitrage incentive for US→EU LNG cargoes. Indirect downward pressure on TTF via lower competing LNG bids into NW Europe.

themes.headline: COP31 draft text signals immediate fossil fuel transition language
themes.why_it_matters: If finalized, heightened international climate commitment increases investor risk premium on legacy coal/gas assets; supports EU EUA price floor expectations and accelerates power-to-renewable substitution narrative. EUA long-dated curve risk.

themes.headline: Middle East oil chokepoint flows surged 19% in Q3 2026
themes.why_it_matters: Higher global crude flow through Strait of Hormuz improves LNG project economics (lower Brent support = wider LNG margins) and alleviates geopolitical supply-shock risk. Marginal reduction in energy security premium; indirect mild TTF relief via LNG.

watchlist: COP31 final text release and fossil fuel transition clause finalization
EU methane rule implementation timeline; industry compliance roadmap
Russian Yamal LNG rerouting logistics; sanctions enforcement timeline from Jan 2027
US LNG export capacity utilization and TTF arbitrage strength through winter 2026–27
